command:

printf 'BOOT_ID='
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'OS_RELEASE\n'
cat /etc/os-release
printf 'KERNEL=%s\n' "$(uname -r)"
printf 'INIT=%s\n' "$(ps -p 1 -o comm=)"
printf 'PACKAGE_MANAGERS\n'
command -v dnf || true
command -v yum || true
command -v rpm || true
printf 'FIREWALL_SOFTWARE\n'
rpm -q firewalld nftables iptables-services iptables 2>&1 || true
printf 'FIREWALL_UNITS\n'
systemctl list-unit-files firewalld.service nftables.service iptables.service ip6tables.service 2>/dev/null || true

printf 'ROUTES\n'
ip -4 route
printf 'LISTENERS\n'
ss -lntup
printf 'SSH_SERVICE\n'
systemctl is-enabled sshd.service 2>&1 || true
systemctl is-active sshd.service 2>&1 || true
sshd -T 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(port|listenaddress|addressfamily) ' || true
printf 'FIREWALL_STATE\n'
command -v firewall-cmd >/dev/null 2>&1 && firewall-cmd --state 2>&1 || true
command -v nft >/dev/null 2>&1 && nft list ruleset 2>&1 || true
command -v iptables-save >/dev/null 2>&1 && iptables-save 2>&1 || true

command:
set -eu
TEST_NS=fwbaseline
HOST_IF=fwbh0
NS_IF=fwbn0
cleanup() {
  [ -n "${SERVER_PID:-}" ] && kill "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
  firewall-cmd --quiet --zone=public --remove-interface="$HOST_IF" 2>/dev/null || true
  ip link del "$HOST_IF" 2>/dev/null || true
  ip netns del "$TEST_NS" 2>/dev/null || true
  rm -f /tmp/fw-baseline-server.py
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
ip netns add "$TEST_NS"
ip link add "$HOST_IF" type veth peer name "$NS_IF"
ip link set "$NS_IF" netns "$TEST_NS"
ip addr add 192.0.2.1/30 dev "$HOST_IF"
ip link set "$HOST_IF" up
ip netns exec "$TEST_NS" ip addr add 192.0.2.2/30 dev "$NS_IF"
ip netns exec "$TEST_NS" ip link set lo up
ip netns exec "$TEST_NS" ip link set "$NS_IF" up
firewall-cmd --quiet --zone=public --add-interface="$HOST_IF"
cat > /tmp/fw-baseline-server.py <<'PY'
import selectors, socket
ports = (8080, 9090, 18080)
sel = selectors.DefaultSelector()
for port in ports:
    s = socket.socket()
    s.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
    s.bind(("192.0.2.1", port))
    s.listen()
    s.setblocking(False)
    sel.register(s, selectors.EVENT_READ)
while True:
    for key, _ in sel.select():
        conn, _ = key.fileobj.accept()
        conn.close()
PY
python3 /tmp/fw-baseline-server.py &
SERVER_PID=$!
sleep 1
ip netns exec "$TEST_NS" python3 - <<'PY'
import socket, sys, time
expect = {22: True, 8080: False, 9090: True, 18080: False}
bad = False
for port, wanted in expect.items():
    s = socket.socket()
    s.settimeout(2)
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        result = s.connect_ex(("192.0.2.1", port))
    finally:
        s.close()
    allowed = result == 0
    print(f"port={port} result={result} allowed={str(allowed).lower()} elapsed_ms={int((time.monotonic()-started)*1000)} expected_allowed={str(wanted).lower()}")
    if allowed != wanted:
        bad = True
if bad:
    sys.exit(1)
PY
printf 'BASELINE_BEHAVIOR_MATCHED=yes\n'

command:
set -eu
TEST_NS=fwreboot
HOST_IF=fwrh0
NS_IF=fwrn0
cleanup() {
  [ -n "${SERVER_PID:-}" ] && kill "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
  firewall-cmd --quiet --zone=public --remove-interface="$HOST_IF" 2>/dev/null || true
  ip link del "$HOST_IF" 2>/dev/null || true
  ip netns del "$TEST_NS" 2>/dev/null || true
  rm -f /tmp/fw-reboot-server.py
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
ip netns add "$TEST_NS"
ip link add "$HOST_IF" type veth peer name "$NS_IF"
ip link set "$NS_IF" netns "$TEST_NS"
ip addr add 192.0.2.1/30 dev "$HOST_IF"
ip link set "$HOST_IF" up
ip netns exec "$TEST_NS" ip addr add 192.0.2.2/30 dev "$NS_IF"
ip netns exec "$TEST_NS" ip link set lo up
ip netns exec "$TEST_NS" ip link set "$NS_IF" up
firewall-cmd --quiet --zone=public --add-interface="$HOST_IF"
cat > /tmp/fw-reboot-server.py <<'PY'
import selectors, socket
ports = (8080, 9090, 18080)
sel = selectors.DefaultSelector()
for port in ports:
    s = socket.socket()
    s.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
    s.bind(("192.0.2.1", port))
    s.listen()
    s.setblocking(False)
    sel.register(s, selectors.EVENT_READ)
while True:
    for key, _ in sel.select():
        conn, _ = key.fileobj.accept()
        conn.close()
PY
python3 /tmp/fw-reboot-server.py &
SERVER_PID=$!
sleep 1
ip netns exec "$TEST_NS" python3 - <<'PY'
import socket, sys, time
expect = {22: True, 8080: True, 9090: False, 18080: False}
bad = False
for port, wanted in expect.items():
    s = socket.socket()
    s.settimeout(2)
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        result = s.connect_ex(("192.0.2.1", port))
    finally:
        s.close()
    allowed = result == 0
    print(f"port={port} result={result} allowed={str(allowed).lower()} elapsed_ms={int((time.monotonic()-started)*1000)} expected_allowed={str(wanted).lower()}")
    if allowed != wanted:
        bad = True
if bad:
    sys.exit(1)
PY
